description: This file defines a generic class 'RoundRobinSelector' implementing a round-robin resource selection algorithm, used within the Orleans streaming framework. It manages a list of resources, randomly ordered, and provides a method to select a specified number of resources avoiding duplicates with an existing selection.

classes.name: RoundRobinSelector<T>
classes.description: A class implementing a round-robin resource selection strategy, maintaining a list of resources and selecting them in a cyclic manner while avoiding overlaps with existing selections.

methods.name: RoundRobinSelector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resource list with a randomly ordered distinct set of resources and sets the initial last selection index.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Property returning the total number of resources managed by the selector.

methods.name: NextSelection
methods.description: Method to select a specified number of resources, avoiding those already in the existing selection, cycling through the resource list.
